tools.name: get_league_commentary
tools.description: Read Fantasy Pundit’s existing canonical weekly commentary and roast for a public FPL mini-league. Use this first for requests to roast, recap, or review a league. It never creates a new edition. At full-time it can report that the current Gameweek is available to reserve while FPL scoring settles.

tools.name: generate_weekly_commentary
tools.description: Create, reserve, or reuse Fantasy Pundit’s one official weekly commentary and league roast for the current available Gameweek. At full-time, a request can be saved and starts automatically as soon as FPL scoring is ready, which may be before FPL changes its public Gameweek label. This can consume sh

tools.name: get_commentary_result
tools.description: Check a Fantasy Pundit weekly commentary and league-roast job returned by generate_weekly_commentary. It never starts generation. When completed, return the exact canonical commentary and share links without rewriting it.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_league_commentary · Public sink: get_commentary_result.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_league_commentary · Public sink: get_commentary_result

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
